implementation_state: Implemented and verified. The opt-in `opencode` feature adds the anonymous free tier at https://opencode.ai/zen: the locked `ProviderClientProfile::OpenCodeCli` shaping identity (the CLI identifier hex48(ts*0x1000+counter)+14 base62, canonical idempotent `ses_` sessions seeded from the first user turn, and the `opencode/<ver>` User-Agent plus `x-opencode-client/project/session/request` headers); body shaping that forces stream, ensures `bash`/`read` are present without rewriting a client tool of the same name, and sets `tool_choice: none` for a tool-less client; a non-streaming client's forced SSE folded back into one `ChatResponse` (buffered_chat); injected `bash`/`read` calls stripped on both the buffered and streaming response paths; `ProviderKind::{OpenCodeZenFree, OpenCodeConsole}` with a validation error when an OpenCode provider uses any profile other than OpenCodeCli; capability-catalog discovery (models.opencode.ai/api.json, cached an hour) enriching DiscoveredModel's new capability/window/free fields; and exclusion from the classifier pool and the election. Verified by 20 unit tests, an in-process fake-gateway integration test replaying the captured SSE, and a live anonymous smoke against the real /zen endpoint returning a non-empty turn.
required_gates: Shaped request passes the free-tier gate (no 403 FreeTierError)
Identifier shape ^ses_[0-9a-f]{12}[0-9A-Za-z]{14}$ with no sequential run
bash+read tool injection for 0/1/many client tool sets
Non-streaming collapse preserves text, thinking, tool calls and usage
Parser tolerates usage-per-chunk, null deltas and the {"choices":[],"cost":"0"} trailer
Discovery derives ids from /v1/models and never hand-derives them
unblock_condition: Not blocked; implemented, unit- and integration-tested, and live-verified against the real gateway.
